name: water_stream_adiabatic_mixing
title: Adiabatic mixing of two water streams (exercise)
summary: Teaching exercise for the adiabatic mixing of two water streams at 250 kPa. Stream 1 is at 80 °C and 0.5 kg/s, stream 2 is at 20 °C, and the mixture leaves at 42 °C. The model computes the unknown inlet flow and the mixture flow from the steady mass and energy balances.

verification.summary: Against the stored solution of 05-75.EES, compare_solution.py reports: 10 common variables, 5 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 0. Maximum over all common variables is 7.19e-01 on h_2. The five are h_1, h_2, h_3, M_dot_2 and M_dot_3. The original mass and energy balances are satisfied.
